blocks.text: Is mein homolysis hota hai, jis se free radicals bante hain jo substrate molecule par attack (hamla) karte hain. Maslan:

Yeh reaction free radical mechanism se hota hai jo Chemistry 11 mein parha ja chuka hai. Pehle initiation hota hai jis mein shuru ke free radicals bante hain. Phir propagation (phailao) ke step mein yeh radicals aur radicals banate hain. Aakhir mein termination hota hai: aik jaise ya alag alag free radicals aapas mein jur jate hain aur reaction ruk jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Light Cl₂ ko do Cl• mein torti hai (initiation). Cl• + CH₄ → HCl + •CH₃, phir •CH₃ + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl• (propagation: har step naya radical deta hai). Do radicals mil jayein, maslan Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂, to chain reaction khatam (termination). Cl₂ zyada ho to yeh chalta rehta hai aur aakhir mein CCl₄ tak pohanchta hai.
